registry_integrity.verification_method: recomputed with the registry's own algorithm: sha256 of file bytes for channel_config/scope, sha256 of json.dumps(entry, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False) for each release entry
registry_integrity.note: release_entries are hashes of the registry entry dicts, not of the patch/manifest files. Hashing the patch files against the seal produces false negatives and must not be used as a tamper signal.

supervision_semantics.single_instance: state/supervisor.lock pid file, validated against tasklist image name
supervision_semantics.health_url: http://127.0.0.1:8791/healthz (probed with an empty ProxyHandler so the machine-wide HTTP(S)_PROXY cannot hijack a loopback probe)
supervision_semantics.restart_policy: 3 consecutive health failures, exponential backoff capped at 60s, reset after 120s healthy
supervision_semantics.inflight_guard: never force-restart while state/inflight.json count>0 and the marker is younger than 900s
supervision_semantics.child_interpreter: sys.executable of the supervisor process (whichever python launched it)
supervision_semantics.adoption: if 8791 already answers /healthz, the supervisor adopts the running bridge instead of fighting for the bind

current_shell_context.privilege: standard user (Limited RunLevel on all existing scheduled tasks)

scheduled_task_unattended_finding.observation: Every BD-related scheduled task uses LogonType=Interactive with principal 15690.
scheduled_task_unattended_finding.implication: None of them can execute while the user is logged off. This is a structural blocker for unattended operation independent of the service question.

requirement_for_new_service.blocking_question: How can a new Inventory service legally survive the end of the agent session?
requirement_for_new_service.answer: It cannot be created from inside the agent session. It must be installed once by the operator with administrator rights as a Windows service (or an S4U/ServiceAccount scheduled task). After installation the SCM owns the process, so agent-turn job objects and session teardown become irrelevant.
